text.name: longdescription
text.text: Created to run LucasArts games using the SCUMM engine. Initially focused on 2D games, it merged with ResidualVM in 2020 to support 3D games.
Creado para poder ejecutar juegos de LucasArts para el motor Scumm. Originalmente pensado para juegos 2D, en 2020 se fusionó con ResidualVM para soportar 3D
